title: SignedLinkOutcomeRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the SignedLinkOutcomeRecorded event (INV-Q-17431): access-svc tells the sender asynchronously whether the link requested by a SignedLinkRequested event was issued or refused. Carries no link reference, passcode or sealed value. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

requestEventId.description: The CloudEvents id of the SignedLinkRequested event this outcome answers.

subjectReference.description: The subject reference, copied from the request.

outcome.description: ISSUED when the link was issued; REFUSED when issuing failed, with reasonCode.

reasonCode.description: Why the issue was refused; required when outcome is REFUSED.
